comment: src/modules/Rimshot.hh:39 declares a BiquadHPF and :45 sets it, so the resonator is a highpass; the manual calls it a bandpass. Cutoff 200Hz to 2000Hz is at :44 and resonance 1 to 10 at :43, both matching the manual. The impulse length, impulseMs, is 0.084 at :80 and its level is 5V at :51; the filter output is tripled at :63 before the -5V to 5V clamp. The manual's remark about the trigger modulating the cutoff is not in this code: nothing changes the filter on a hit.
